shots.vo: Okay, if you just bought Carpe, or you're about to, watch this first.
shots.still: Close-up, the hand holds the capped Carpe stick up close to the lens at a slight angle, front label toward the camera, the vanity soft behind it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-5s): the hand brings the stick up toward the lens, gives it one small shake like a person showing a friend, then holds it steady with the label facing the camera.

shots.vo: When it's new, it looks empty. It's not.
shots.still: Close-up, the hand holds the uncapped stick upright; the white ribbed dome sits just below the rim and looks dry. The cap lies on the counter.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand tilts the open stick toward the lens to show the dry dome, then turns it back upright.

shots.vo: Just keep twisting. It takes a bunch of turns the first time,
shots.still: Close-up of both hands: one holds the open stick, the other's thumb and index finger grip the orange knob at the base.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the fingers turn the knob again and again, five quick turns; on the last turns the white dome rises slightly and a little lotion appears between the ribs.

shots.vo: and you need way less than you think, like, a pea.
shots.still: Macro close-up of the dome with one small pea-sized bead of white lotion on top; the index fingertip hovers just beside it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the fingertip points at the small bead, circles it once in the air, then pulls back.

shots.vo: Too much is how you get that white crusty stuff people post about.
shots.still: Close-up: the dome with far too much lotion piled on top; the hand holds a folded tissue next to it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand wipes the extra lotion off the dome with the tissue in one stroke, leaving only a thin layer.

shots.beat: dry skin, night, let it dry, morning
shots.vo: Put it on dry skin at night, and let it dry before your shirt goes on. Then again in the morning.
shots.still: Close-up of the vanity in warm evening lamp light: the hand rests on a folded white towel, a plain black t-shirt folded next to it, the capped stick beside them.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-2.5s): the hand pats the towel twice like drying off. Shot 2 (2.5-5s): the hand waits, fingers tapping slowly on the folded black t-shirt, then lifts the shirt.

shots.vo: The label says clinically tested for up to a hundred hours, but that's when you use it like this.
shots.still: Close-up of the capped stick held upright, the white '100hr' shield badge sharp and readable, the index fingernail resting beside it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-3s): the fingernail taps the 100hr badge once. Shot 2 (3-6s): the hand tips the stick side to side a little, a casual 'eh' gesture, then holds it still.
shots.insert: 0.8s badge close-up cropped from this still, laid over 'a hundred hours' so the badge reads sharp

shots.vo: Oh, and this one's Vanilla Peach. (laughs) It smells like a peach candle, in a good way.
shots.still: Close-up on the vanity: the uncapped stick stands next to one ripe peach; the hand rests beside them.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-6s): the hand picks up the stick, brings it toward the lens as if letting you smell it, then sets it down next to the peach and gives the peach a little nudge.

shots.still: Medium close-up of the vanity: the capped stick stands centred, label facing the camera; the hand hovers just above it.
shots.video: Shot 1 (0-4s): the hand sets the stick down, taps the cap once, then points down toward the bottom of the frame and holds.
